program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_p": (6.0, 4.0, 12.0),     # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX
    "L_p":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),     # pass L (intrinsic gain -> PSRR at max load)
    "N":      (5.0, 2.0, 12.0),     # pass : gate-diode mirror ratio
    "gmid_n2":(5.0, 4.0, 12.0),     # NMOS transconductor gm/Id at Imax/N
    "L_n2":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Itail":  (20e-6, 10e-6, 30e-6),# EA tail current
    "gmid_in":(14.0, 8.0, 20.0),    # EA differential pair gm/Id
    "L_in":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),     # EA L (DC gain ~40)
    "Rz":     (33e3, 5e3, 100e3),   # lag network: sets EA gain near UGF ~ gm_in*Rz
    "Cz":     (30e-12, 5e-12, 100e-12),
    "Idiv":   (4e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),  # feedback divider current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vsup = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    vo = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    N = p["N"]
    Idiv = p["Idiv"]
    Itail = p["Itail"]
    Ib2 = 5e-6

    # Pass device and gate diode (mirror 1:N, diode is W/N)
    Ipmax = imax + Idiv
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Ipmax, vds=vsup - vo)
    Wd = mp.W / N
    vgate_min = vsup - mp.vgs

    # NMOS transconductor sinking the diode current
    n2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n2"], p["L_n2"], Ipmax / N, vds=max(vgate_min, 0.2))

    # EA: PMOS differential pair (bulk = own source), NMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Itail / 2, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["L_in"], Itail / 2, vds=0.55)
    m5 = lut.size("p", 12.0, 1.0, Itail, vds=0.3)
    mb3 = lut.size("p", 12.0, 1.0, Ib2, vds=m5.vgs)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.65)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", 12.0, 1.0, Ib2, vds=vsup - mb3.vgs)

    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = (vo - vref) / Idiv

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias chain
    n.dev("MB1", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MB2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("MB3", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mb3)
    n.dev("M5", "cs", "pb", "vin", "vin", m5)
    # error amplifier
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vref", "cs", "cs", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "fb", "cs", "cs", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "nz", p["Rz"])
    n.C("CZ", "nz", "vss", p["Cz"])
    # adaptive gate driver
    n.dev("M6", "gate", "out1", "vss", "vss", n2)
    n.M("MD", "gate", "gate", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wd, p["L_p"], m=1)
    mfp = int(min(200, max(1, round(mp.W / 50.0))))
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "gate", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mfp)
    # feedback divider
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    # ---------- analytic predictions ----------
    beta = vref / vo
    gm1 = m1.gm
    ro1 = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A1dc = gm1 * ro1
    w1k = 2 * PI * 1e3
    z1 = complex(1, w1k * p["Rz"] * p["Cz"])
    pz = complex(1, w1k * (ro1 + p["Rz"]) * p["Cz"])
    A1_1k = abs(A1dc * z1 / pz)
    A1hf = gm1 * p["Rz"] * ro1 / (p["Rz"] + ro1)

    Gm_max = beta * A1_1k * n2.gm * N
    gL = mp.gds + 1.0 / (R1 + R2)
    Zo = 1.0 / complex(gL, w1k * cl)
    L1k = abs(Gm_max * Zo)
    psrr = db(1 + L1k)

    ugf_max = beta * A1hf * n2.gm * N / (2 * PI * cl)
    p_out1 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * p["Rz"] * (n2.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd))
    gm_d = mp.gm / N
    p_gate = gm_d / (2 * PI * (mp.cgg * (1 + 1.0 / N) + n2.cdd))
    pm_max = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_max / p_out1)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_max / p_gate))

    iq = iref + Ib2 + Itail + Idiv + (imin + Idiv) / N

    dvgs = 0.35
    vout_err = 100 * (dvgs / A1dc) / beta / vo

    dvfb = dvgs / (gm1 * p["Rz"])
    under = min(dvfb, Itail / gm1) / beta + imax * 60e-9 / cl

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": under,
        "ripple_settled": 0.002 if pm_max > 45 else 0.02,
        "ugf_max_hz": ugf_max,
        "pm_max_deg": pm_max,
        "vgate_min": vgate_min,
        "W_pass_um": mp.W,
    }
